Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-November 2024

Body.Content:
In mid-November 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

 

  • You can now set up a network security perimeter (NSP) in Azure SQL Database. An NSP defines a boundary around a group of platform as a service (PaaS) resources, providing implicit trust access between each resource. The perimeter enforces egress control, trusted communication between services, and visibility into PaaS-to-PaaS communication. SQL Database is one of the 16 services that support NSP.


Learn more
